questions.title: Counting Sort Work Estimate
questions.description:
Counting an array of n values into k buckets does n reads to count plus k bucket resets plus n writes to rebuild: 2n + k operations in total. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long countingSortOps(int n, int k)

It must return 2n + k.

Input Format:
One line with n and k.

Output Format:
One line with the operation estimate.

Constraints:
1 <= k <= n <= 100000

questions.title: Growth Gap Between Algorithms
questions.description:
A profiler compares two schedulers: the legacy one performs n^2 operations, the new one performs n * floor(log2 n) + n. Report how many MORE operations the legacy scheduler performs. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long growthGap(long n)

It must return n * n - (n * floor(log2 n) + n). floor(log2 1) is 0; compute the logarithm with a halving loop, not floating point.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the gap (may be 0).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000

questions.title: Pizza Cutting Pieces
questions.description:
A pizzeria found that n straight cuts across one pizza produce at most 1 + n * (n + 1) / 2 pieces (the lazy-caterer sequence). Compute the maximum piece count. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long pizzaPieces(int n)

It must return (n * n + n + 2) / 2 — zero cuts still leave 1 piece. Use long maths.

Input Format:
One line with the number of cuts.

Output Format:
One line with the maximum number of pieces.

Constraints:
0 <= n <= 100000

questions.title: Count Nested Loop Iterations
questions.description:
The analysis loop pair is "for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) { ... } }". Count the total body executions of the inner loop. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long nestedCount(int n)

It must return n * (n - 1) / 2 — the triangular count. Use long so large n does not overflow.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the inner-loop execution count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000

questions.title: Count Halving Steps
questions.description:
The loop "while (n > 1) { n = n / 2; }" halves n until it reaches 1. Count the loop iterations. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int halvingCount(int n)

It must return how many times the body runs (0 when n is already 1).

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the halving count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000

questions.title: Count Strided Loop Iterations
questions.description:
The loop "for (int i = 1; i <= n; i += 2) { ... }" steps over only the odd positions. Count the body executions. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int stridedCount(int n)

It must return the count, which is (n + 1) / 2 with integer division.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the iteration count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000

questions.title: Binary Search Probe Estimate
questions.description:
A librarian who searches a sorted shelf of n books with binary search needs at most floor(log2 n) + 1 probes in the worst case. Estimate the probes. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int binarySteps(int n)

It must return the worst-case probe count: halve n repeatedly and count the halvings, then add 1 (n = 1 needs exactly 1 probe).

Input Format:
One line with the number of books.

Output Format:
One line with the worst-case probe count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000

questions.title: Sensor Pair Monitor
questions.description:
A pipeline monitors every ADJACENT pair of its n sensors, so a linear scan performs n - 1 comparisons. Count them. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long adjacentComparisons(int n)

It must return n - 1 (0 for a single sensor).

Input Format:
One line with the number of sensors.

Output Format:
One line with the comparison count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000

questions.title: Triple Loop Work Count
questions.description:
A weather model runs "for i < n { for j < i { for k < j { ... } } }" — the body runs once for every triple i > j > k, which is the combination count C(n, 3) = n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long tripleCount(int n)

It must return the innermost body execution count. Use long maths.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the innermost-loop execution count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000

questions.title: Halving Work Total
questions.description:
An algorithm halves the workload after every stage but still processes the whole remaining workload at each stage: at stage 1 it does n units, stage 2 does n / 2 units, and so on while the workload is positive. Sum the work units (integer division each halving). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long halvingWork(long n)

It must return n + n/2 + n/4 + ... while the term is positive. For n = 10 that is 10 + 5 + 2 + 1 = 18.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the total work units.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000000

questions.title: Count Single Loop Iterations
questions.description:
A warm-up loop runs "for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { ... }". Count how many times the body executes as a function of n. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int loopCount(int n)

It must return the number of body executions. You may compute the answer directly — no loop is needed.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the iteration count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000

questions.title: Two Sequential Loops
questions.description:
Two loops run one after the other, each from 0 to n - 1. Sequential work ADDS. Count the total body executions. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long sequentialCount(int n)

It must return 2 * n.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the total iteration count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 50000

questions.title: Slower Algorithm Detector
questions.description:
Algorithm A performs n^2 operations; Algorithm B performs 100 * n operations. Report which one does MORE work. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int slowerAlgorithm(long n)

It must return 1 when n * n > 100 * n, and 0 otherwise (equal work also returns 0). Use long maths.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with 1 or 0.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000

questions.title: Image Filter Operations
questions.description:
A photo editor applies two filters to an n x n image, and each filter touches every pixel exactly once. Count the total pixel operations. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long pixelOperations(int n)

It must return 2 * n * n. Use long maths so large images do not overflow.

Input Format:
One line with the image size n.

Output Format:
One line with the total pixel operations.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Handshake Counter
questions.description:
At a party of n guests every pair of guests shakes hands exactly once. Count the handshakes — the classic n * (n - 1) / 2 pairing count. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long handshakes(int n)

It must return the handshake total.

Input Format:
One line with the number of guests.

Output Format:
One line with the handshake count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000

questions.title: Doubling Steps to Exceed Limit
questions.description:
A viral post shares double every hour starting from n shares. Count how many doublings happen until the share count EXCEEDS the platform limit. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int doublingSteps(long n, long limit)

Repeat "if current <= limit, double it and count one step" while current <= limit; return the number of doublings. For n = 1 and limit = 10 the counts go 2, 4, 8, 16 — four steps.

Input Format:
One line with n and the limit.

Output Format:
One line with the number of doublings.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000000, n <= limit <= 1000000000000000000

questions.title: Sum of Squares Work Count
questions.description:
A drawing routine draws row i with i * i dots. Counting the dots for n rows means summing 1^2 + 2^2 + ... + n^2, which equals n * (n + 1) * (2n + 1) / 6. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long sumOfSquaresOps(int n)

It must return the closed-form sum. Use long maths.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the dot total.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000

questions.title: Slowdown Threshold
questions.description:
An O(n^2) backup job blows its one-second budget when n * n exceeds the machine's operations-per-second rating. Find the smallest input size that overshoots. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long slowThreshold(long opsPerSecond)

It must return the smallest n >= 1 with n * n > opsPerSecond.

Input Format:
One line with the operations-per-second rating.

Output Format:
One line with the smallest failing n.

Constraints:
1 <= opsPerSecond <= 1000000000000

questions.title: Merge Sort Recursion Depth
questions.description:
Top-down merge sort splits a segment of size n into halves of n / 2 and n - n / 2 and recurses; a segment of size 1 is a base case at depth 0. The recursion DEPTH is the largest number of split levels anywhere in the call tree. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int mergeSortDepth(int n)

depth(1) = 0; depth(n) = 1 + max(depth(n / 2), depth(n - n / 2)). For n = 5 the answer is 3.

Input Format:
One line with n.

Output Format:
One line with the recursion depth.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000

questions.title: Collatz Step Counter
questions.description:
A number-theory screensaver walks n by the Collatz rule: halve n when it is even, otherwise replace it with 3n + 1, counting one step per move until n reaches 1. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long collatzSteps(long n)

It must return the number of steps (0 when n is already 1). Use long — the values grow before they shrink.

Input Format:
One line with the starting number.

Output Format:
One line with the step count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000000000
